t_advice_summary_textbox.text: gnomes are in matched sets, choose smaller hat then colour - mushroom number changes but feels consistent to brain, which can recognise patterns before conscious mind, so go with gut

vb_textbox.text: The gnomes will come in the same pairs throughout the experiment.  I would recommend going for the shorter gnome, if that is an option, otherwise go with your gut, especially if it feels like you're not getting a lot of mushrooms
